# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Organ of the arifOS Federation

> GEOX is the Earth Intelligence organ of the arifOS Federation: a governed MCP
> service for geological, geophysical, hazard, and earth-science reasoning.
> Creed: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — "truth must cool before it rules."
> GEOX computes. It never adjudicates, never seals, never books resources.
> Counts in this file are a build-time snapshot from the organ's registry
> (canonical = 27, snapshot 2026-10-03T05:08Z); operators verify live parity
> at the organ `/drift` endpoint.

## Endpoints

- MCP endpoint: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp
- Health: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/health
- Agent profile: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/profile
- Scenarios: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/scenarios
- WebMCP manifest: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/.well-known/mcp.json

## Auth (current position)

Authenticated, not open. Connectors send a pre-registered `X-MCP-Client-Id`
header (exact-match registry, P3_AUTH_LITE) or perform full OAuth 2.1 + DPoP.
Governed tool calls may additionally require federation-issued credentials via
the AAA control plane. There is no anonymous tools/list.

## Capabilities

- 27 canonical MCP tools (underscore names, e.g. `geox_basin`, `geox_claim`,
  `geox_observe`): basin screening, claim lifecycle, seismic interpretation and
  evidence spine, petrophysics, well ingest/QC, multimodal Earth observation,
  paleobiology, GLOF hazard, prospect advisory, map/spatial/deep-time.
  Full generated inventory: https://github.com/ariffazil/GEOX (tools_sot.yaml).
- 20 MCP App widgets (SEP-1865 GUI, live bindings): WellDesk, Seismic Vision,
  Earth Volume, Risk Console, Judge Console, Basin Explorer, Prospect Studio,
  Geoprobe, and more.
- A2A negotiation via the AAA control plane (federation-internal; no public port
  is disclosed here).

## Epistemic Contract (E1–E5)

- E1 Every response carries an epistemic layer: `OBS | DER | INT | SPEC`, and
  `UNKNOWN` when there is no data — refusal is an output, not a failure.
- E2 SPEC outputs are capped by RASA ≤ 0.90 and labeled hypothesis.
- E3 Irreversible/high-risk calls return `status: 888_HOLD` until sovereign human release (F13).
- E4 GEOX never seals. Constitutional SEAL verdicts belong to the arifOS kernel
  (`arif_judge`) alone. `geox_claim(mode='seal')` is organ-local claim
  bookkeeping, not a judgment.
- E5 Irreducible uncertainty is always declared — it is never a fixed percentage.

## What GEOX cannot know (physics limits)

Non-uniqueness · seismic tuning/resolution · time≠depth until velocity-calibrated ·
fluid ambiguity (fizz gas vs commercial gas on amplitude) · equifinality ·
sparse-well interpolation · erased time at unconformities. GEOX names the limit
and the next measurement; it does not pretend them away.

## Governance

Constitutional floors F1–F13 of the arifOS Federation apply to every call.
F13 — Sovereign Human Veto (888_HOLD) — is load-bearing: a human can always
stop the machine. Federation siblings: arifOS (judgment), A-FORGE (execution),
AAA (attention), WEALTH (capital), WELL (vitality), arifFlow (receipts) —
public repos under github.com/ariffazil. Internal ports are intentionally not
disclosed.

## Quickstart (60 seconds)

1. Point your MCP client at `https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp` with your
   registered `X-MCP-Client-Id` header (or OAuth 2.1 + DPoP).
2. Call a real tool, e.g.
   `geox_basin(basin_name="Malay Basin", mode="profile")`.
3. Expect refusal as behaviour: a carbonate image without an HCl field test
   returns `state: INPUT_REQUIRED` with the exact requested test — never a guess.
